{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Dress: formal A-line dress with a fitted bodice, V-neckline, flutter sleeves and a softly flared skirt, ankle length, in dusty sage green (#8A9A7B), silk satin-crepe
Shoes: open-toe sandals with a mid block heel and a slim ankle strap, in champagne beige (#D8C3A5), smooth leather
Clutch: small structured envelope clutch in champagne beige (#D8C3A5), silk satin
Earrings: pearl drop earrings with a small frame, in soft gold (#C9A24D) and ivory pearl, gilded metal
Sunglasses: slim softly rounded cat-eye frames in tortoiseshell brown (#6B4A2F), acetate

This outfit meets the formal dress code through a silk dress of noble fabric in an ankle-length cut. The dusty sage works in the afternoon daylight and stays clear of white, ivory and the bride's likely palette, which suits a sister of the couple. The block heel keeps you steady on grass during the outdoor ceremony and still looks polished at the restaurant afterwards. In August warmth the light, breathable silk needs no outer layer, and the champagne and gold accents keep the look cohesive and festive."}
